title: Llama 3B tuned on US real-estate compliance
intent: Fine-tune Llama 3B on US real-estate compliance: Fair Housing Act, RESPA, TILA/TRID, state licensing
rationale: Tavily gathers the regulations, Nemotron 3 Super writes grounded Q&A from them, and Token Factory fine-tunes Llama 3.2 3B with LoRA. Token Factory's per-token LoRA deploy is unverified for 3B (spike 1), so vllm-serve hosts base and adapter on one AI Cloud endpoint for 30 min; Nemotron 3 Ultra then judges base against tuned on held-out questions with the source passage as reference.

queries: Fair Housing Act obligations of real estate agents and landlords
RESPA Section 8 kickbacks and referral fees in real estate
TILA-RESPA integrated disclosure (TRID) loan estimate and closing disclosure timing
US state real estate license requirements and continuing education
seller property condition disclosure requirements by state

inputs.instructions: Questions a US real-estate agent, broker or loan officer asks about compliance; answers in at most three sentences, using only the passage.
